summary: Iteration 58 — Backend pytest 7/7 PASSED (cities seed + meeting-request full lifecycle). Frontend Playwright smoke covered Settings users table, venues modal, transport modal, photovideo + ratings rows, and Meetings page request/inbox flow. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: Venues 'Yeni' modal does NOT render the Şəhər managed-select (data-testid='managed-city' count = 0). Root cause: `/app/frontend/src/pages/organization/configs.js` line 16 still defines venue `city` field as `type: 'text'` — main agent's claim that it was switched to `type: 'managedselect'` with `list_key: 'cities'` is NOT reflected in code. Everything else from the spec verified end-to-end.

minor.issue: Computed endpoint does NOT surface rows from db.notifications collection — meeting_request notifications are persisted in DB but invisible to the in-app notifications dropdown. Inbox uses /api/meeting-requests directly, so functional impact = 0, but unread badge for meeting-request notifs is not driven from /api/notifications.

ui_bugs.issue: Şəhər field renders as plain text input instead of managedselect bound to cities list. data-testid='managed-city' count = 0. Spec requirement #2 not met.

issues: Uses native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar component — consistent with rest of app but flagged per global UX standard.

Phone fields render correctly with placeholder '+994551234567' and 'phone' type wires the digit-only + +994 blur handler in VendorModule.jsx, but inputs lack data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='field-phone'), making the digit-stripping/blur-prefix behavior hard to verify by automation.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): In /app/frontend/src/pages/organization/configs.js line 16, change venue city field from `{ key: 'city', label: 'Şəhər / Rayon', type: 'text', group: 'Əsas' }` to `{ key: 'city', label: 'Şəhər / Rayon', type: 'managedselect', list_key: 'cities', group: 'Əsas' }`. VendorModule already handles managedselect with data-testid='managed-city' and loads /settings/manageable-lists?key=cities — only the config flip is missing.
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid attributes to phone field <input> elements (e.g. data-testid={`field-${field.key}`}) in VendorModule.jsx FieldInput for testability.

OPTIONAL: Surface rows from db.notifications (filtered by recipient_id) in /api/notifications response so meeting-request notifs feed the global notification dropdown (currently only Inbox modal shows them).
critical_code_review_comments: configs.js venue 'city' field type='text' contradicts spec & main-agent claim. The same field is used across venues only (transport correctly omits city). Single-line fix.
VendorModule.jsx hidePhotoView only excludes 'photovideo'. Ratings module uses a separate OrgRatings.jsx page (not VendorModule) so the exclusion list is correct — no change needed.

Backend meeting-requests respond endpoint correctly recomputes overall status from per-recipient statuses and atomically inserts meetings for sender + all recipients when fully accepted. Idempotent if same recipient re-accepts (status overwritten in place).

respond() uses check_permission('meetings','write') — recipient must have meetings:write to accept/reject. Acceptable since all internal users get this by default; future granular roles should explicitly allow 'respond' even without 'write'.

create_meeting_request inserts notification docs but /api/notifications endpoint never reads them — dead branch unless a separate /api/notifications/feed endpoint exists. Confirmed dead-end for end-user visibility.
MeetingRequest sender_name is captured at creation time; if a sender renames themselves, old requests show stale name. Minor.

When recipients list is later edited (not currently supported), there is no validation that recipient_ids belong to active users. Current create_meeting_request loads recipients via find() with no status filter — inactive users CAN be selected as recipients. Low priority.
test_credentials: Admin settings@marsol.az / marsol123. Ephemeral TEST_recip_*/TEST_recip2_* users created+deleted per pytest module run.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates 2 TEST_ prefixed Aktiv users per run + multiple meeting_requests + 3 meetings (from full-accept test). All cleaned up via fixture teardown: users deleted by id, meetings deleted via DELETE /api/meetings/{id}, rejected request leaves no residual meetings. Verified post-run: residual TEST_ users = 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter58 verified backend meeting-requests + cities seed via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration58_meeting_requests_cities.py (re-runnable, idempotent, self-cleaning). Frontend gap = venue city still type='text' in configs.js — main agent must flip to managedselect+list_key='cities'. After fix, re-run only the venues smoke: open /organization/venues → click 'Yeni' → assert document.querySelector('[data-testid="managed-city"]') is non-null and Select dropdown lists 15 cities (Bakı, Sumqayıt, Gəncə, ...). MeetingRequest modal participant list is rendered as a scrollable list — confirmed populated with all active users including settings@marsol.az itself (own row should be excluded — minor enhancement, not blocking).
rca of the issue: managed-city missing: VendorModule.jsx::FieldInput correctly renders <Select data-testid=`managed-${field.key}`> only when field.type === 'managedselect' (line 74-83). The venue config in configs.js line 16 was never updated; field still has type:'text'. Fix is a single key swap + add list_key:'cities'. No backend / no VendorModule change required.
